summary: Design: identity via members.token with kind-scoped lookups and seed-safe upserts; opt-in gating middleware with an unauthenticated allowlist; owner claim with rotation; single-use invites + member.joined protocol event; material sync as runner-side HTTP pull; static serving + /health; source-run Docker images with first-boot-only seeding; gated check script. state.request: Make Ada deployable as a Railway one-click template: the open-source self-host rung between laptop and hosted (DECISIONS §4b, §16, §19; research/2026-08-23-railway-deploy-template.md, -buzz-identity-and-agents.md, -shared-filesystem-on-railway.md). Decisions taken by Ignacio on 08/23 to record as DECISIONS.md §20: (a) one deploy = one course community; (b) identity copies Buzz's pattern with plain tokens instead of Nostr keys — an owner token bootstrapped from a deploy-time variable claims the teacher, the teacher mints invite links, members live in a server-side table, and membership gating is an explicit flag (off for local dev, on in the template); (c) runners stay outside the deploy by default (teacher's machine, their claude login, wss already works), with an OPTIONAL runner service in the template where the org pastes its own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — the credential lives in their Railway project, never with us. Build: (1) the server serves apps/web/dist so one public service carries UI+API+WS; (2) minimal identity per (b): person tokens, claim/join flow in the web client replacing the person picker when gating is on, writes and person WS authenticated; (3) Dockerfile for the server service — build web, seed the example course into the volume on first boot (ada.db + data/<course>), env-driven config, runner agent token overridable per deploy via env; (4) Dockerfile/entry for the optional runner service running the claude runtime with the org's API key; (5) README gets the Deploy on Railway button placeholder and a deploy runbook documents creating/publishing the template and connecting a local runner; (6) docs land in the same change (DECISIONS §20, AGENTS.md files of touched areas, PRODUCT.md if terminology changes). Out of scope: multi-course/multi-tenant, permissions screen, SSO, billing, npm-publishing the runner, actually publishing the template in Railway's dashboard (manual step, runbook only), any shared filesystem service.
